title: NASA | A Year in the Life of Earth's CO2
summary: A short NASA Goddard visualization from the GEOS-5 model showing a year of atmospheric carbon dioxide moving around the globe. It shows plumes from sources, hemispheric differences and seasonal swings as plants grow and die back.
why: HN commenters use it as a vivid illustration of how CO2 is distributed and how vegetation absorbs it seasonally.

quote.text: it was eye opening for me, and seemed obvious upon seeing that video
